Microcomputer.subject: Applied Sciences
Microcomputer.question: The _____ was Small computer with a CPU made out of a microprocessor.
Microcomputer.fact: A microcomputer is a small, relatively inexpensive computer having a central processing unit (CPU) made out of a single integrated circuit microprocessor. Microcomputers became popular in the 1970s and 1980s with the advent of increasingly powerful microprocessors such as the MOS Technology 6502, Zilog Z80, and Intel 8088.
